title: Do Not Destroy Our Minbars!
body:
Dastur, yaa Sayyidee. (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
Zid habeebika `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa suroora wa ridwaanan sultaana. Thumma as-salaamu `alaykum
yaa anbiyaullah wal awliyaullah wa man tabiahum bil insaan 'ila yawm al-qiyamah. A`oodhu billahi min ashShaytani 'r-rajim. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! The Sword of Heavens, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'rRaheem, has been granted to us by the Lord of Heavens! Say it and don't fear, astaghfirullah! Thumma
salaamu `alaykum yaa Saahib az-Zamaan! Thumma salaamu `alayk yaa Aqtaab, Awtaad, yaa Budalaa, yaa
Nujabaa, yaa Nuqabaa, amidoona madadikum antum Saahib al-Imdaad.
This broadcast is to reach to everyone. It is not from Earth, but it is the broadcast from heavenly ones.
Beware of being against this broadcast, or it may be your lives will be down or your life is going to be
tasteless. Beware! Huuuu.

O People! Say, "We are weak servants." And I am an old and weak servant. The Lord of Heavens, by His Holy
Command to His most beloved one, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), ordered that there must be successors in
every time who are reaching something and giving something. It is a chance for addressing all Mankind on
this planet.
O our Attenders! Marhaban bikum! As-salamu `alaykum. For this reason, try to be present and give a short
time to attend. Perhaps a sign may come to you through this address, guiding you to a treasure of the
Heavens that might lead you to be granted a heavenly crown.
O People! That chance has been granted to everyone; all may be crowned. Why are you losing that chance? In
this world you may find only about forty people who have been crowned in this life, but the chance to attain
those heavenly crowns is granted to everyone. There is not only one crown, they come daily. Those who will
attend such heavenly markets may reach a different crown daily, and that is never going to be the same as
yesterday’s. Therefore, on the Day of Judgment, when the history of their life runs in front of them, people
will see that for some days they were granted special crowns and for some days they were no, then they will
be so regretful, saying, "Why? How did we lose it? We lost it for nothing!" but their chance is finished.
O People! Special crowns are coming from Heavens to Earth each day, looking to see if anyone deserves
them; if not, those crowns are given to others. Also, these crowns are accompanied by heavenly keys that
open heavenly treasures. Who are not present, those keys are not given to them and they will be regretful on
the Day of Resurrection, saying, "Oh! We lost that treasure," but their regrets are useless. Those keys are not
going back, but the holy order commands, "Give these keys to who are ready," then they will come to whoever
are present for that sale, like buyers running to a sale in the market. Every day that opportunity comes. Why
are you not attending?
O our Attenders! Be clever, open-minded, good-understanding ones, who daily give their most high glory to
their Lord. You say, "I am so busy, there is no time for me to come to listen, to buy something." What is the
value of the whole dunya? The Seal of Prophets (s) said in the Divine Presence, the value of all dunya and its
treasures is not worth the wing of a mosquito! Why are you running, making excuses, "I am so busy, I have
no time to sit and hear something." That means you are no-mind ones! Angels may say, "Ptuuh, spit on you,
no-mind people, working with fertilizer and not looking that here there are treasures!" What is this? How are

you accepting to be such people who prepare fertilizer and leave diamonds, emeralds, rubies and jewels? How
then are you saying, "We have a clever understanding." You are at such a low level of understanding!
O Salafi `ulamas! Don't blame a person or be angry with who is calling people to real, heavenly treasures. I
am not speaking from myself, no! I know where my level is, but something that we are speaking on, you must
say that. You are looking at yourself through a mirror that is showing man bigger than his actual size.
Therefore, you are saying, "Oh! I am such a big one." You are not, so come to your real size. What is the real
size of Man? Say! Wahhabi people are no-minded, never understanding, but you are saying you are `ulamas,
so say what is the real position for Man to run after! Where is the honored throne of kings, why are you not
saying? Who is going to reach a heavenly throne daily? Why are you not making them wake up? What are you
teaching people? Are you teaching something, maa laa yaaneeh, useless?
People are asking what is going to be best for them, here and Hereafter. Here it doesn't matter, but Hereafter,
which thing makes Man a glorified, honored and praised servant in the Divine Presence? Why are you not
saying this, and you claim you are `ulamas! Wahhabi people are not knowing anything, except some useless
opinions that never happened and which no one understands. They are against every good thing that has
been granted to Mankind, which is being used for the honor of the Seal of Prophets (s)! Your enmity is on
that point, and you are no-mind people! Do you think Allah Almighty needs something from His servants?
No! But it is granted to the Seal of Prophets (s), and through him it is granted to his nation, ummat alHabeeb (s)!
O People! Think about he Day of Resurrection, when so many people will be seated on thrones and the
prophets will be on minbars! That is the honor of Islam, and no-mind Wahhabi people destroyed the symbol
of the Jumu`ah khutbah in Haramayn al-Shareefayn, in Meccat al-Mukarramah! Why? It was an honor! They
are no-mind people, turning endlessly in a circle but never getting out. Their understanding is at the point of
zero! Now they are bringing a small chair, and the khateeb who is giving khutbah on the holy day of Jumu`ah
stands and speaks. Why? What is the reason to destroy that minbar, which was five hundred years old?
Manaabir, are mentioned in the holy hadeeth of the Seal of Prophets (s), that on the Day of Resurrection
prophets will be on manaabir. Do you think that chair is a minbar? Why did you destroy it? You think you did
your best, but you did your worst!

And `ulamas of other countries are silent on this issue, never speaking on it! Keep old things for reminding
us of the `azhamat al-Islam, the Glory of Islam!. Everywhere throughout east and west there are manaabir, so
how are you destroying this? If it is forbidden, then why are you not destroying Rawdah ash-Shareefah?
Come and touch it! The first person to touch it (with ill intent) will fall down dead at that very moment, but
they are afraid. Therefore, I am saying that minbars will be granted to prophets on the Day of Resurrection,
and those who are following them will have chairs, thrones.
O Salafi `ulamas! Are thrones more honorable, or manaabir? Say it, for people to hear in the east and west!
Thrones are for kings and sultans, but minbars are for prophets! On the Day of Resurrection you will find it,
but for you there will be nothing! Salafi `ulamas will be made to stand, with no chairs for them to sit on, and
that will be their punishment!
Now the Muslim world is sleeping! So many `ulamas in Egypt and throughout the east and west are silent,
not reprimanding those Wahhabis in Hijaaz who are destroying the minbar and making the khateeb sit on a
chair, so that they may push him and bring him like a handicapped person. There will come a time to build a
minbar of gold, inshaa-Allah (swt)! You did so many wrong things, and Allah Almighty will give you
punishment here and Hereafter, because you never protected the honor of Islam, of prophets, and of
`ulamas! May Allah forgive us.
O People! Listen, think about what you hear and then obey! If not, you will be punished here and Hereafter.
May Allah forgive us, for the honor of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s).
Fatihah.
(38 minutes)
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks to Shaykh Hisham Effendi and Hajjah Naziha on the phone.)
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`at Salaat ash-Shukr.)
